name: Binaltorphimine
summary: Binaltorphimine (BNI) is a selective antagonist of the κ-opioid receptor (KOR). BNI and norbinaltorphimine (nor-BNI) were the first highly selective KOR antagonists to be discovered.

pharmacology.text: Binaltorphimine (BNI) is a selective antagonist of the κ-opioid receptor (KOR). BNI and norbinaltorphimine (nor-BNI) were the first highly selective KOR antagonists to be discovered.

uses.en: It is a laboratory research tool used to study the kappa opioid receptor. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究 kappa 鴉片受體的實驗室工具，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究 kappa 鸦片受体的实验室工具，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: It is two naltrexone-like halves joined together. Making a double molecule was the trick that finally produced a drug selective for the kappa opioid receptor, which had resisted earlier attempts.
fact.zh: 它由兩個類似納曲酮的半邊接合而成。製成雙分子正是最終取得 kappa 鴉片受體選擇性藥物的關鍵手法，先前的嘗試都未能成功。
fact.zhHans: 它由两个类似纳曲酮的半边接合而成。制成双分子正是最终取得 kappa 鸦片受体选择性药物的关键手法，先前的尝试都未能成功。
